quality.outcome_percentile_basis: the realised gameweek total's position among the simulated outcomes of the squad Gaffer recommended, stored before the deadline — a percentile within your own squad's simulated range, NOT a rank against other managers
quality.explanation: A pre-deadline record exists for this gameweek, but it is missing `decision.comparison.move_expected`, so the decision's expected value — and therefore its quality — cannot be scored. What the record does support is reported: the result was close to what your own squad's distribution predicted, so luck is not the story.

lesson.text: Only 1 reviewed gameweek(s) so far — not enough to separate a pattern from variance.

limitations: The pre-deadline snapshot exists but recorded no `decision.comparison.move_expected`, so the decision's expected value is unknown and its quality is not scored. Everything else in the snapshot — the recommended squad and its stored outcome distribution — is present and is used. Gaffer omits the comparison when there is no held squad to compare a move against, which is every snapshot taken before the season's first deadline.

outcome_percentile is the realised gameweek total's position among the simulated outcomes of the squad Gaffer recommended, stored before the deadline — a percentile within your own squad's simulated range, NOT a rank against other managers.
The hindsight column is the best XI available with the benefit of the results; it was not knowable before the deadline and is never used to score a decision.
